title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: Income support of Rs 6,000 per year paid in three equal instalments to eligible landholding farmer families.
description: PM-KISAN is a central sector scheme of the Government of India that provides direct income support to landholding farmer families. The amount is transferred directly to the bank accounts of beneficiaries.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families, subject to exclusion criteria defined by the Government of India (for example, certain income-tax payers, institutional landholders and specified professionals are excluded). Selection is as per the official scheme guidelines.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year, released in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 every four months, credited directly to the beneficiary bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar card, land ownership records, bank account details (for direct benefit transfer), and a mobile number. Documents are as required on the official portal.
application_process: Registration is done online through the PM-KISAN portal, or through a Common Service Centre / the local revenue or agriculture office. Existing beneficiaries complete e-KYC on the portal.
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
source_note: Seeded for demonstration. Administrators must verify all details against the official portal before publishing to farmers.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to unforeseen events.
description: PMFBY is a crop insurance scheme that aims to provide comprehensive risk cover against failure of crops due to natural calamities, pests and diseases, and to stabilise farmer income.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers with valid land records, are eligible. Scheme enrolment windows are announced officially each season.
benefits: Insurance cover against crop loss. Farmer premium share is capped by the scheme (for example, a lower share for kharif and rabi food crops and for commercial / horticultural crops, as per official guidelines).
required_documents: Aadhaar, land records or tenancy agreement, bank account details, and crop sowing details. Exact documents are as specified on the official portal.
application_process: Enrolment is done through the PMFBY portal, banks, Common Service Centres, or the designated insurance company before the notified cut-off date for each season.
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
source_note: Seeded for demonstration. Administrators must verify all details against the official portal before publishing to farmers.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
summary: Provides farmers with timely access to credit for cultivation and other needs through a credit card facility.
description: The Kisan Credit Card scheme gives farmers access to short-term credit for crop production and other requirements. It is issued by banks and supported by an interest subvention for prompt repayment.
eligibility: Farmers (owner cultivators as well as tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers, as permitted by the issuing bank) are eligible. Eligibility assessment is done by the issuing bank.
benefits: Access to short-term production credit with a limit based on the bank assessment, and an interest subvention on prompt repayment as per the applicable government guidelines.
required_documents: Identity proof, address proof, land documents or tenancy proof, passport-size photographs, and bank account details as required by the issuing bank.
application_process: Apply at any branch of a participating bank, or through the PM-KISAN / bank channels as announced. The bank verifies documents and sanctions the limit.
source_note: Seeded for demonstration. Administrators must verify all details against the official portal and the concerned bank before publishing to farmers.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
title_hi: प्रधानमंत्री किसान ऊर्जा सुरक्षा एवं उत्थान महाभियान (पीएम-कुसुम)
summary: Scheme to promote solar energy in agriculture by supporting solar pumps and small solar power plants.
description: PM-KUSUM aims to provide energy security to farmers, reduce dependence on diesel, and enable farmers to earn from surplus solar power. It covers decentralised solar plants and solar pumps.
eligibility: Farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives, panchayats and water user associations, as specified under the different components of the scheme. Component-wise eligibility is defined officially.
benefits: Support (subsidy and/or financing) towards installation of solar pumps and solar power plants, and potential additional income from surplus solar power as per the component guidelines.
required_documents: Aadhaar, land records, bank account details, and component-specific documents as defined by the implementing agency / DISCOM.
application_process: Applications are invited by the implementing agency or DISCOM through official notifications and the national / state portals.
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
source_note: Seeded for demonstration. Administrators must verify all details against the official portal before publishing to farmers.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
summary: Provides farmers with soil health cards containing crop-wise nutrient recommendations based on soil tests.
description: The Soil Health Card scheme issues soil health cards to farmers at regular intervals. Each card reports the status of soil nutrients and gives crop-wise fertiliser recommendations.
eligibility: Farmers across the country can get their soil tested and receive a Soil Health Card through the scheme, as implemented by the State Governments.
benefits: A soil health card with nutrient status and crop-wise nutrient / fertiliser recommendations, helping optimise fertiliser use and reduce input cost.
required_documents: Aadhaar or identity proof, land details, and contact information as required by the local agriculture department.
application_process: Samples are collected by the local agriculture department or through the Soil Health Card portal; the printed card is provided to the farmer.
source_note: Seeded for demonstration. Administrators must verify all details against the official portal before publishing to farmers.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
summary: A voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing a defined monthly pension after the age of 60.
description: PM-KMY is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers, with a matching central government contribution, administered by the Life Insurance Corporation of India.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers (as defined by the scheme) aged between 18 and 40 years, who are eligible under the scheme parameters, may enrol. Exact age and land criteria are per official guidelines.
benefits: A monthly pension of Rs 3,000 on attaining the age of 60 years, subject to the scheme contribution terms and the official scheme rules.
required_documents: Aadhaar, bank account / savings account details, and self-declaration of eligibility, as per the official portal.
application_process: Enrolment through the nearest Common Service Centre or the PM-KISAN portal, as per the official process.
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / LIC
source_note: Seeded for demonstration. Administrators must verify all details against the official portal before publishing to farmers.
